transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I can help you with questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after your surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I'm also very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity is not normal, especially if your eye is also red and painful. If you are experiencing this, we may need to assess it further. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I have one more question. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for your vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. This should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had for now. Thank you for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I've got all the information I needed. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
